followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: The Sudanese border order is supported and remains included as a formal policy phase rather than an observed closure of every crossing. Kassala governor’s order covers all Eritrea border crossings. Directions, affected traffic categories and exceptions are not independently established; their unknown cells remain appropriate. The order took effect the evening of 5 January 2018. A 31 January 2019 reopening announcement and July procedural talks do not establish actual restored passage. Retain the 391-day date difference only as a qualified formal-policy confirmed-through measure, not a complete operational duration. All four current assignments were assessed: arms collection and trafficking are attributed emergency explanations; alleged rebel support is a reported retrospective reason; diplomatic dispute is explicitly analytical bilateral context, not exclusive official purpose. Three Sudan Tribune pieces and the Anadolu announcement were freshly read. Their repeated announcement content is not four independent operational observations. The formal-policy phase remains unlocated with a legal-policy temporal rule; no all-post physical enforcement or gate geometry is inferred.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 75f71973a192fafd898d69eee3f642a94b186f28c8ab91f32c95fb2d2560df1a. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the full fixed sample audit of 16 parents and 27 phases, including 29 guarded input-cell corrections and the new Sadao onset question. Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R05-BQ04 — Actual first reopening for ordinary passage remains unresolved under FUQ-039. Policy evidence is supported within the recorded limitations, not every operational claim verified.
